purpose: advance the frozen v4 submission surface only by integrating the post-outcome descriptive BOP species-baseline decomposition and reviewer-facing interpretation, without changing any prospective endpoint, model, comparator or terminal category
title: State-resolved ecological prediction: from flat suitability to transferable ecological-state distributions

bop_primary_endpoint_preserved.prospective_primary_comparator: pooled hierarchically weighted training marginal P(A)

required_manuscript_changes: Methods explicitly state that the original BOP comparator is pooled across species while species identity is a predictor
Methods define the post-outcome species/context additive decomposition and state that it cannot alter the prospective endpoint
Results report overall and species-level decomposition including the contrasting Buteo and Circus pygargus patterns
Results state that species-specific altitude-state counts are supplied in review evidence
Discussion limits the original BOP gain to species-aware prediction over a pooled marginal rather than a pure environmental-context effect
Discussion states that the decomposition shows context dominates the overall descriptive mean but component structure is heterogeneous among species
